grammar_errors.mistake: He put a wrong ending on the verb (-iini) for the object 'me'; Amal recast it as بيسألني and he repeated it.
Adjective after a definite (possessed) noun needs el-; Amal prompted 'what do we need before بيض?' and he added الـ.
grammar_errors.fix: But what do we need before بيض? ... Because it's بساسك. It's definitive.

grammar_errors.mistake: For 'that we have' he said a garbled form with a loose يا; Amal said No and gave اللي عندنا (ending on عند); he admitted he forgot the ending.
grammar_errors.said: اللي، oh، إن-- اللي and home يا.

grammar_errors.mistake: The fish (سمكة) is feminine, so the verb is كانت; Amal recast كانت.
Feminine سمكة takes a feminine adjective; Amal repeated كانت a second time after he already had كانت, prompting the adjective, and he moved to بدا (engine for بيضا).

grammar_errors.bucket_name: aa5er / a5eer: before or after the noun
grammar_errors.mistake: 'The last one' for a fish (feminine) is الأخيرة; Amal pointed to سمكة and gave أخيرة; he said الأخيرة.
grammar_errors.fix: هلأ إحنا بنحكي عن سمكة so ... أخيرة.

grammar_errors.mistake: The adjective agrees with لون (masculine), not the fish; Amal gave أسود and named why.
grammar_errors.fix: لون. هه؟ ... أسود. 'Cause now we're describing the لون.

grammar_errors.mistake: Animals in general take el-; Amal said كل الحيوانات and he repeated ما أحبوا الحيوانات في البيت.
He used the you-(fem) past ending -ti for 'I looked'; Amal said 'You, not me' and he said اتطلعت.
Look at = اتطلع على; he left out the preposition and Amal prompted 'what does طلع take?', he said على.
grammar_errors.fix: Before, before can. What is it? طلعت. What does طلع take؟

grammar_errors.mistake: 'When I was small' needs the I-ending كنت; Amal cut in (لما م--) and he said لما كنت صغير at the same second - may be his own fix, needs audio.
He wanted 'she didn't have a tail' (after مش ديل); Amal said ما and he said مكان عندها.
grammar_errors.said: and this is feminine كان عندها

grammar_errors.bucket_name: noun, not verb, after a preposition
grammar_errors.mistake: 'By mistake' needs bi + noun, not a verb; Amal recast بالغلط and he repeated it.
Other than / different from is غير عن; he said غير من then غير البس, Amal said عن and he said 'that's right'.
'The animals I see most' is present (bashuf); he used past shufit; Amal said 'You see, not saw'.
After bi the street keeps el-; Amal recast (engine wrote الشاة) and he said El shaara.

grammar_errors.bucket_name: taani: before or after the noun
grammar_errors.mistake: 'My second favorite' = حيواني المفضل التاني; he put التاني before المفضل and Amal said 'Flip it'.
After indefinite تاني حيوان the adjective takes no el-; Amal said No and 'No El'.
grammar_errors.fix: No, you don't even need the مفضل ... مفضل عندي ... No El.

grammar_errors.mistake: Prefer X over Y = بفضل X على Y; Amal said La and he said على إشي.
'Her chickens' needs the possessive ending, not el-; Amal said No, 'her chickens'.
grammar_errors.said: لا بتستنى لا. No. بتستنى الجاجات.

grammar_errors.mistake: 'Invited' is past; he used the present بيعزم, Amal said 'Invited' and he said عزموني.
Adjective after a possessed (definite) noun takes el-: خروفي المريض; Amal recast المريض.
Complain to me = بيشكوا لي; he tried مني then علي, Amal said No to each and gave بيشكوا لي.
grammar_errors.said: مني. No, no, no, مني is like about...
grammar_errors.fix: No, to me. ... No. ... Yes. بيشكوا لي.

grammar_errors.mistake: With صار لها the duration comes straight after, no لـ; Amal said No لا, just فترة.
grammar_errors.said: سار لي-- سار لها لا فاترة.
grammar_errors.fix: No لا just فترة. صار لها فترة.
